reference_law: Each intended map is the declared exact linear action tensored with identity on arbitrary external references; no separability or normalization premise. These are expectations, not observed results.

cases.name: left-remove
cases.expected: +1 left unitor, preserves every Bit/reference coefficient

cases.name: left-insert
cases.expected: +1 inverse left unitor, preserves every Bit/reference coefficient

cases.name: right-remove
cases.expected: +1 right unitor on two ordered Bits axes

cases.name: right-insert
cases.expected: +1 inverse right unitor on two ordered Bits axes

cases.name: roundtrips
cases.expected: Both packaged and unpackaged round trips are exact identity; g also exercises Bits0

cases.name: zero-unit-pair
cases.expected: Zero physical axes retain the exact binary basis tree and both logical owners

cases.name: nested-product
cases.expected: One retained inner (Bit,Unit) owner; no implicit flattening or nested split

cases.name: tuple-provider
cases.expected: Closed Op<(Unit,Bit)> binds the complete tree and the explicit Apply capability

cases.name: removed-unit-phase
cases.expected: Removing a separately phased Unit factor contributes omega on all Bit/reference coefficients

cases.name: controlled-four
cases.expected: Four omega factors on packaged target become Z on control, target Bit/reference untouched

cases.name: ordered-axes
cases.expected: X acts on the first/low ordered axis only: basis index j maps to j xor 1

cases.name: same-width-wrong-tree
cases.expected: Must reject a same-width left-nested to right-nested implicit conversion

cases.name: bits0-is-not-unit
cases.expected: finish cannot consume Q<Bits0> even when it came from a packaged product

cases.name: implicit-destructure
cases.expected: Runtime tuple patterns must not split a packaged quantum owner

cases.name: aliased-zero-owner
cases.expected: join must reject using one Q<Unit> owner twice

cases.name: lost-revived-owners
cases.expected: Lost, revived and wildcard Unit owners reject; earliest error may mask later declarations

cases.name: wrong-arities
cases.expected: Split unary/join binary/zero statics and immediate binary shape; errors may mask siblings

cases.name: effectful-argument
cases.expected: Complete effectful argument evaluation must not become Unitary through packaging

cases.name: unused-zero-fold
cases.expected: All bodies are checked; zero iterations cannot hide duplicate consumption, unused cannot hide loss

cases.name: finite-coherent-unitors
cases.expected: Existing coherent basis unitor +1 consumes/returns an owner; selected coherent do still unsupported

cases.name: finite-split-join
cases.expected: Existing binary split/join round trip is identity, preserving order and exact nested metadata

cases.name: existing-atom-control
cases.expected: Unchanged Bit H-H identity control, independent of new tuple support

limits: Grouped invalid declarations require isolated follow-up tests; first rejection proves nothing about masked siblings.
No direct phase_eighth(Q<Tuple>) expansion; phase is on the explicitly separated Unit factor.
Existing finite controls do not imply new unit/finish parity or selected coherent lifts.
